title: SAFESORA: Towards Safety Alignment of Text2Video Generation via a Human Preference Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Human preference annotation and multi-label classification of text-to-video pairs to identify negative visual stereotypes, prejudices, or demeaning representations against racial or ethnic groups (evaluated under the 'Racial Discrimination' harm category).

Human preference annotation and multi-label classification of text-to-video pairs to detect discriminatory symbols, stereotypes, or bashing targeted at specific genders (evaluated under the 'Other Discrimination' harm category).
Human annotation of generated videos and prompts to identify insulting, demeaning, or discriminatory visual content and contexts targeting religious groups.
Human annotation of generated videos and prompts to identify insulting or discriminatory visual content targeting individuals based on their sexual orientation.
